commits.messageBody:
Повернуто значки CI, API Docs і Lint, яких не було з часів Лаб 1.

Додано посилання, яких бракувало за зауваженням проміжного оцінювання:
static-analysis.md, review-report.md, debugging-log.md, threat-model.md,
data-model.md, traceability-matrix.md, docs/validation/ і міні-ТЗ.

Нові розділи «Якість коду (Lab 5)» і «Валідація (Lab 7)»; у розділ
специфікації додано посилання на опубліковану документацію GitHub Pages.

decisions/ згадано ADR-005.

Статуси ADR приведено до фактичного стану й узгоджено з індексом:

реалізовано, скрейпер заплановано), ADR-004 (маніфести підготовано, PR #81).

commits.messageBody:
The regression test guarding the DM_CONVERT_CASE fix in ErrorCode.anchor()
was deleted in 6e11a75 during a test reorganisation. The Locale.ROOT fix
itself survived, so nothing failed and the loss went unnoticed, while
static-analysis.md kept referencing the test as an existing artifact.

Restored with Locale.of("tr", "TR") instead of the deprecated constructor.
Verified it still fails without the fix: reverting Locale.ROOT reproduces
expected: <invalid-parameter> but was: <ınvalıd-parameter>.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The static analysis and testing documents still described the project as it
was on 14.10.2026 — no database, no authentication, 16 classes, one test
level. All figures re-measured on a clean ./mvnw verify and npm run
test:coverage run.

static-analysis.md
- Checkstyle 20 -> 129 findings, SpotBugs 14 -> 71 (2 after exclusions)
- document the four exclusion groups that hide 69 of 71 findings, and why
  suppressing SPRING_ENDPOINT removes the rule that found our one real
  vulnerability
- show that 94 of 129 Checkstyle findings come from two config decisions
  (allowMultipleEmptyLines, MagicNumber over test sources), not defects
- CRLF_INJECTION_LOGS: fixed in code via LogSafe, still reported because
  find-sec-bugs does not recognise custom sanitisers
- the documented vulnerability (unauthenticated writes) is closed by
  SecurityConfig and proven by AuthFlowIntegrationTest
- record that the ErrorCodeAnchorTest regression test had been deleted
- drop the stale note about GitHub Actions being disabled

testing-strategy.md, testing/README.md
- the pyramid is no longer flat: 115 backend tests (3 integration) and 14
  frontend tests, line coverage 45.1% -> 62.1%
- name what is not covered and why: 192 lines of JDBC repositories need
  Testcontainers, calendar sits at 12.5%
- the 5% jacoco-check gate no longer catches anything; raising it is the
  first open action
- fix the snapshot refresh command, which copied to the wrong path

progress.md
- Auth and PostgreSQL were marked not started and in-memory; both are done
- add the 12 endpoints missing from the table (auth, heads, logo, images)
- note that storage/ has no component code in the traceability matrix

review-log.md
- status note on the coverage-gate finding: 38% -> 62.1%, so the proposed
  35% threshold is already too low

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
